    first = 0xc0|(w-1)
    return datagram(bytes([first])+b'\0\0\0\1'+bytes([len(dcid)])+dcid+bytes([len(scid)])+scid+v(len(token))+token+v(w+len(payload))+pn.to_bytes(w,'big')+payload,[ann])
